planets.name: TOI-5789 c
planets.description: TOI-5789 c crosses its star every 12.9 days and is 2.9 times as wide as Earth, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-5789 c was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-5789. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
